footnote_text: The transaction reported in this row consists of the grant by the Issuer's board of directors to the Reporting Person of 28,283 ordinary shares represented by 28,283 restricted share units ("RSUs"), pursuant to the Issuer's 2019 Equity Incentive Plan. || The 28,283 RSUs reported in this row vest and settle for underlying ordinary shares in four equal semi-annual installments of 25% each following the vesting commencement date of August 13, 2026--on February 13, 2027, August 13, 2027, February 13, 2028 and August 13, 2028-- subject, in each case, to the Reporting Person's continuous employment by the Issuer as of the applicable vesting date, such that by the two-year anniversary of the vesting commencement date (August 13, 2028), all underlying shares will be issued to the Reporting Person.
